events.verdict: Siakam (TOR) is in the path of Dinwiddie (BKN) on the pick and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Allen (BKN) is in the paint for more than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) puts two hands to the back of VanVleet (TOR) on the pick but does not deliver contact and dislodge him.
Siakam (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Dinwiddie (BKN).
Leonard (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position on Dinwiddie's (BKN) shot.
Siakam (TOR) makes marginal contact with Allen's (BKN) body during his shot attempt near the rim.

[Observable in enhanced video] Allen (BKN) is in the paint for more than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.

VanVleet (TOR) briefly places his arm around Alllen's (BKN) leg when he attempts to disengage from the screen but the contact does not affect Allen's FOM.
Leonard (TOR) is in a legal guarding position on the drive by Russell (BKN) and cleanly tips the pass.

VanVleet (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball when he steals it from Allen (BKN). Both Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) and Russell (BKN) are signaling for a timeout but the Nets do not have possession of the ball. Additionally, Leonard (TOR) has possession of the ball when the 24-second shot clock expires so there is no whistle.
Siakam (TOR) and Allen (BKN) make incidental contact as they both go for the loose ball.
Dinwiddie (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position on Leonard (TOR) during the drive.
Russell (BKN) deflects the ball away from Siakam (TOR) and makes incidental contact with his arm after the ball is already loose.

Russell (BKN) steps out of bounds with the ball. Although he signals for a timeout, a player shall not be granted any timeout if both of his feet are in the air and any part of his body has broken the vertical plane of the boundary line. Russell was deemed to have possession of the ball prior to stepping out of bounds and the shot clock is reset.
Siakam (TOR) is in the path of Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) when he absorbs the contact on the pick.
Hollis-Jefferson (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position on Leonard's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Any marginal contact to the arm of Allen (BKN) is after the timeout called by the Nets.

Leonard (TOR) puts a hand/forearm to Dinwiddie's (BKN) side during his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Leonard (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position on Dinwiddie's (BKN) shot and cleanly dislodges the ball.
